name: Barbarian: Clanlord's Totem makes nearby allies deal extra Frost damage on direct hits
contract: Clanlord's Totem 804737: 'The totem emanates an aura for 8 sec, causing allied players (party or raid members, target 56) within range to deal ${$AP*0.35} additional damage as Frost damage when they deal direct damage.' The ability hands 560530 to the allies in range; 560530 is a proc aura (231) that must fire Frost damage 560529 on the ally's direct damage.

steps.label: The ally carries the totem aura
The ally's direct hits deal the extra Frost damage
The Frost damage carries the Barbarian's attack power share
